scope: Exact inherited notice blocks only. No content-level attribution, printed-book verification, product-code mapping or complete book-level inherited chain is established.
hashMethod: SHA-256 of the complete physical notice line encoded as UTF-8, excluding its line ending; no trimming or normalization.
inventoryNote: The ticket contains 15 occurrences of 14 unique immutable keys. Occurrences 7 and 8 repeat the same Mite line-164 key; they resolve to one canonical Registry record. The unlisted line-165 trailing-space variant is not added, corrected or aliased; its original text remains in the upstream permanent notice block.

comparisons.result: The complete Killer Frog notice literally uses Authors Scott Greene and Clark Peterson without a colon. Kostchtchie literally uses Revised.© without a separating space. The Mongrelman Revised notice uses Copyright 2002 and Author Scott Greene without a colon. Literal wording, spelling, capitalization and punctuation are preserved; no editorial correction or alias is established.

Ticket occurrences 7 and 8 repeat the same line-164 hash. Line 165 differs only by one final ASCII space and has a different immutable hash absent from the ticket. It is outside this review: no Registry record or alias is added, no normalization is applied, and the unchanged upstream permanent notice block retains both physical lines.

Two distinct complete physical Mite notices. Line 164 names Tome of Horrors Complete and © 2011 with Frog God Games publication/distribution; line 166 names Tome of Horrors, and © 2002. Both credit Scott Greene, based on original material by Ian Livingstone and Mark Barnes. These are distinct immutable blocks, not aliases; no version equivalence or complete book coverage is inferred.

Two distinct complete physical Mongrelman notices. Line 167 names Tome of Horrors Complete and © 2011 with Frog God Games publication/distribution; line 168 names Tome of Horrors Revised, and Copyright 2002. Both credit Scott Greene, based on original material by Gary Gygax. These are distinct immutable blocks, not aliases; literal wording is preserved without inferring version equivalence.

The complete book notice lines literally title the works Monster Codex (© 2014, Paizo Inc.) and Mythic Adventures, (© 2013, Paizo Publishing, LLC). Their exact author lists and punctuation are preserved. These individual lines establish neither product-code aliases nor the books’ complete inherited notice chains.

The complete Marid notice literally names the Tome of Horrors III, © 2005, Necromancer Games, Inc., and Scott Greene. It is not joined or aliased to other Marid notices from different Tome of Horrors versions.
